title: "Blessings By The Sea" in Watercolor | 30A | Coast Property Management – Coast Properties
meta_description: "Blessings By The Sea" in Watercolor | 30A | Coast Property Management
description_expanded: Welcome to “Blessings By the Sea” – our renovated 4-bedroom, 4.5-bathroom home in WaterColor. LOCATION: Located in the Crossing District of WaterColor - one of the most highly sought-after communities along Scenic Highway 30A On a quiet street just around the corner from the Dragonfly Pool 4-minute golf cart ride or 5-minute bike ride to the WaterColor Beach Club Minutes from the town centers of WaterColor and Seaside featuring restaurants, shopping, and family activities PROPERTY OVERVIEW: 1st Floor: Open concept kitchen, dining, and living area Dining table seating for eight with an additional four seats at the large kitchen island Gourmet kitchen with stainless steel appliances Spacious screened-in porch with seating Bedroom 1: Primary owner suite: King bed + fully-renovated bathroom (walk-in shower, double vanity) Office nook Fully-renovated powder room Laundry room 2nd Floor: Living area with flat-screen TV Bedroom 2: Secondary owner suite: King bed + twin bed with trundle (sleeps up to 4), flat-screen TV, and private balcony with porch swing. Fully-renovated bathroom (walk-in shower) Bedroom 3: King bed with fully-renovated bathroom (walk-in shower, double vanity) Bedroom 4: Bunk room: Custom twin beds (x2) Fully remodeled hallway bathroom (shower/tub combo) AMENITIES: 6-Seater Golf Cart included with rental Four premium beach cruisers Access to WaterColor Beach Club (amenity passes for up to 10 guests) Access to all six heated WaterColor pools Private 2nd floor balcony with porch swing Outdoor shower Coffee makers: Keurig + standard drip Community green space directly behind home To enhance your stay, we also provide a starter supply of premium, eco-friendly guest essentials, including: Body Wash, Shampoo & Conditioner Hand Soap, Dish Soap & Dishwasher Pods Toilet Paper, Paper Towels & Facial Tissues ️ Trash Bags & Dish Sponge Laundry Detergent GUEST SUPPORT: Need assistance? Coast’s dedicated management team is available to help with anything you need—just give us a call! IMPORTANT NOTES: Age Requirement: The primary guest must be 25 or older to book. Parking: The home comes with driveway parking for a car, as well as community parking permits. Check-In Policy: Please do not arrive before your scheduled check-in time. No Pets & No Smoking: This home has a strict no-pet policy. Unauthorized pets will result in immediate eviction and loss of rental fees, with the guest responsible for any damages. The home is also strictly non-smoking.

Cleanliness: All towels and bedding washed in hot water that's at least 60ºC
